title: 🚨 NEW MSFS PC Activities! Fly the B747 Singapore Tropical & Emirates A320 Captain Missions NOW!
description:
Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update (March 22, 2026): New MSFS Missions & Activities! This week’s MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update for PC features the must-have B747 Singapore Airlines mission pack and new Airbus A320 missions. If you are looking for the best MSFS activities 2026, these new long-haul jumbo jet challenges and "What If" scenarios are perfect for your next flight.

Stay updated with the Microsoft Flight Simulator Weekly Update as we explore the latest MSFS mission packs and unique exploration content.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 4AIR Missions B747 Singapore Tropical (Fly long-haul jumbo missions in Singapore Tropical colors)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: A320 Captain - Emirates What If (Alternate-reality Emirates A320 mission set)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places - full package (Explore curated destinations worldwide)

If you enjoyed this quick weekly roundup, don’t forget to like the video 👍, subscribe for more MSFS Marketplace updates, and drop a comment below letting us know which of these new activities you’ll be flying first!

✈️ See you in the skies!
